Infosys Limited commits to invest Rs30cr. (~$3.5m) in Yali Deeptech Fund I (https://yali.vc) as part of Infosys Innovation Fund.
AI and DeepTech areas, especially Semiconductors continue to evolve rapidly and are key to Infosys strategy with increased usage across Infosys clients for creation of intelligent products, experiences, and business transformation.
Yali is a Bengaluru based early-stage venture capital fund focused on Deeptech areas across Semiconductors, AI, Advanced Manufacturing, Robotics, Genomics, Aerospace/Defense and SpaceTech. Infosys Innovation Fund seeks to partners with Yalis ecosystem and startups to complement Infosys capabilities, and jointly co-create next-generation solutions bringing the power of DeepTech and Semiconductors to help Infosys clients navigate their business transformation.
The investment will be made as and when the capital is called over the investment period of approximately 4-5 years.
